newsitem.title: UK: UK's FTSE sets record close but Dow disappoints.
newsitem.headline: UK's FTSE sets record close but Dow disappoints.

text.p: The UK stock market hit record highs on Tuesday but ended on a subdued note after Wall Street failed to live up to a promising start.

The FTSE 100 index, underpinned by soaring sterling, firm gilts and Wall Street's record close overnight, had reached a record 4,063.2 points earlier in the day and looked poised for further gains as the U.S. market was tipped to open higher.

But late-afternoon dealing saw the Dow Jones Industrial Average pare its initial 34-point gain and the FTSE, suspicious of the U.S. market's stamina, slipped to end the day off highs at a record close of 4,050.8, up 12.1 points.
